description: The kubeconfig answer both surfaces show (#5250, #5322), hand-written. The console's tests/lib/clusters/kubeconfig-access.test.ts asserts buildKubeconfigAccess(facts) equals `access` for every case; apps/cli/cmd/clusters_get_test.go asserts `alethia cluster get` renders `access` as exactly `rows`. A wording change on either side fails one of them until this file is edited, so the cluster card and the terminal cannot drift apart. Every expectation is written out by hand, never rebuilt with the builder's own template.

cases.id: aws: the mint is primary, the aws CLI is the alternative
gcp: a REGION value makes a regional cluster, so --region

access.alternative: gcloud container clusters get-credentials gke-euw3-prod-web --region europe-west3 --project acme-prod-123

rows: gcloud container clusters get-credentials gke-euw3-prod-web --region europe-west3 --project acme-prod-123

cases.id: gcp: a ZONE value makes a zonal cluster, so --zone

access.alternative: gcloud container clusters get-credentials gke-euw3-dev-web --zone europe-west3-a --project acme-dev-123

rows: gcloud container clusters get-credentials gke-euw3-dev-web --zone europe-west3-a --project acme-dev-123

cases.id: azure: the alternative uses the RECORDED resource group
azure with no recorded resource group: the mint still works, there is just no alternative
hetzner: the mint is the only way, and it is offered
alibaba: the mint is the only way, and it is offered
a namespace/vcluster environment gets the mint refusal's own sentence and no command at all

access.note: Kubeconfig mints are not available for an environment placed on a shared cluster.

rows: Kubeconfig mints are not available for an environment placed on a shared cluster.

cases.id: a cluster name a shell would misread is selected by its id, and gets no cloud command
a cloud with no minter gets a note, not a guess

access.note: Alethia has no kubeconfig command for civo clusters.

rows: Alethia has no kubeconfig command for civo clusters.

access.note: Alethia does not know which cloud this cluster runs on, so it cannot build the command.

rows: Alethia does not know which cloud this cluster runs on, so it cannot build the command.
